title: camouflage-contract.json
description: What every Camouflage component is, in the base notes' own names: its parameters, slots, callbacks and component-theme fields. Tools read it (the generator, the MCP server, Studio) and each library checks itself against it. Version 1 is a draft shared with srctool/camouflage#64 and the generator; the web fields live under `web`, so Kotlin and Dart add theirs beside it.

name.description: The contract name without the `Camo` prefix, in PascalCase: `Button`, `SegmentedControl`.

themeFields.description: The component theme (`ButtonTheme`): one entry per field, by its contract name.

kind.description: `value` is data (text, a number, an enum, a boolean), `slot` is a widget or layout content, `callback` is an event the user causes.

values.description: For an enum: its values, in the contract's PascalCase (`Solid`); the web spells them lowercase kebab-case (`solid`).

default.description: The default, as JSON; absent means required or null.

defaultSlot.description: A single layout slot (`content`) is the default slot on the web.

web.description: How the web carries the field: `variable` (the default) is a `--camo-<component>-<field>` custom property; `tokens` is a structured value (a text style, a set of colors) that the web takes from the global typography and color tokens; `gap` is a value that changes structure or behavior, which a CSS variable cannot (the renderer is pure JavaScript and reads no styles), so the web does not offer it yet.
